Node intent: engines.node is ">=20" (declared-support floor only) and every CI job (ci, ci-windows, plugin-mount) configures node-version 22, so 22 is the CI-tested major and the preferred selection; no author-recommended major is visible because both READMEs exceeded the collection bound. Development package manager is pnpm 11.8.0 per package.json packageManager, which CI reads via pnpm/action-setup. The plugin-mount lane pins @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.1 as its author validation baseline, which is an author claim, not a Radar compatibility result. No SDK, ACP, headless, or TUI workflow is evidenced, so only the web profile is selected.
